items.title: Do You See Me?
items.subtitle: Learning to See People the Way Jesus Does
items.description: A reflection on seeing beyond labels, honoring the dignity and stories of overlooked people, and learning to see with the compassion of Jesus.
items.author: Brent D Kern

items.title: Do You See Me? — Sermon
items.description: A companion message to the article, exploring how Jesus sees people and calls His followers to stop, listen, and respond with compassion.
items.author: Brent D Kern

items.title: Have You Ever Fed Jesus?
items.description: An invitation to see Christ in the overlooked and hurting, keeping faces and dignity at the center of practical love.
items.author: Brent D Kern

items.title: The Least of These
items.description: Have you ever fed Jesus? A message about recognizing Christ in people who are hungry, vulnerable, displaced, or overlooked.
items.author: Brent D Kern

items.title: Have You Ever Fed Jesus? — Devotional
items.description: A brief devotional on seeing Jesus in the overlooked and letting compassion replace contempt.
items.author: Brent D Kern

items.title: Leave or Go
items.description: Does God call us merely to leave a place, or does He call us to go toward another place and purpose? A helpful reflection for anyone discerning a journey of service.
items.author: Brent D Kern

items.title: I Walked Today Where Jesus Walked
items.description: A reflective song about encountering the places and story of Jesus, inviting travelers to let sacred journeys deepen their faith.
items.author: Brent D. Kern
